_comment: Crawl seeds. Scope is the exact host of each entry, so a subdomain needs its own line. Every one of these was checked to allow WuzzyBot before being added.
_removed: docs.attest.org was dropped on 2026-09-05: it renders client-side and yields no indexable content. Its sitemap lists attest.sh URLs, which 301 to attest.org, whose own sitemap has one entry and whose only server-rendered page is marketing copy. Re-adding it needs headless rendering, not another seed line.
